title: Price-check script every 30 minutes, posts only when it prints
source: x-usage #14: script-only routine, empty output sends nothing; the price file changes mid-run via a files inject.

files.Documents/scripts/kiln-shelf-price.sh:
#!/bin/sh
p=$(tr -dc '0-9' < "$HOME/Documents/prices/kiln-shelf.txt")
if [ "$p" -lt 60 ]; then
  echo "Kiln shelf 16in is \$$p at Bay Ceramic Supply (usually \$74)"
fi

chat.goal: Run the price-check script in Documents/scripts every 30 minutes and only post when it prints something. No AI for it.
chat.opener: can you run my price-check script (Documents/scripts/kiln-shelf-price.sh) every 30 min and only post when it prints something? don't use AI for it
chat.label: setup

judge: Wren sets a 30-minute script-only routine on the given file with no AI turn; the first hour is silent, and once the price file says 55 the script's line is posted as is.
